comments.headline: Zoning setback lines not shown or verified
comments.summary: Required MF-2 zoning district setback lines are not drawn, labeled, or dimensioned on site plans. Compliance with setback standards cannot be verified, and variance need cannot be determined without reference to required standards.
comments.attn: Verify whether platted setback lines from the recorded 1975 Mecey Subdivision (Vol. 73, Page 76) differ from current MF-2 code requirements. If different, letter of non-enforcement from the City may be required.

details.text: Required setback boundary lines (front, rear, interior side, street side yards) not clearly drawn as continuous boundaries, labeled, or dimensioned on site plan. Individual point-to-point building dimensions shown (15.0'–29.8' to property lines), but required setback boundary lines not depicted. Site Data Table on Sheet 9 identifies MF-2 zoning but does not specify required setback distances.

runComments.comment: Required zoning district setback lines (front yard, rear yard, interior side yard, street side yard) are not clearly drawn as continuous boundaries, labeled, or dimensioned on the site plan. Individual point-to-point dimensions from buildings to property lines are shown (15.0' to 29.8'), but the required setback boundary lines themselves are not depicted. The Site Data Table on Sheet 9 identifies the zoning as MF-2 but does not specify the required setback distances.

Required zoning district setback lines are not shown, labeled, or dimensioned on the site plan, grading plan, or landscape plan for the northern, eastern, and southern property boundaries. Only the western boundary (Valley View Road) shows a labeled platted setback. All required yard setback lines for the MF-2 zoning district must be clearly drawn, labeled, and dimensioned on the site plan.

details.text: Zoning district setback compliance cannot be verified. While some point-to-point building dimensions are shown (15.0'–29.8'), required minimum setback distances for MF-2 zoning district are not displayed. Dimensioned setback lines with required values must be clearly provided for northern, eastern, and southern property boundaries.

runComments.comment: Zoning district setback compliance cannot be verified. While point-to-point dimensions from buildings to property lines are labeled on the site plan (ranging from 15.0' to 29.8'), the required minimum setback distances for the MF-2 zoning district are not shown on the plans. Without the required setback standards displayed, the applicant's compliance with LDC § 25-2-492 cannot be verified.

Compliance with zoning district setback distances cannot be verified because required setback lines are not shown with dimensions from property boundaries to buildings. No dimensions are provided on the site plan, grading plan, or landscape plan showing the distance from building faces to the northern, eastern, or southern property lines. Provide dimensioned setback lines for all property boundaries with required setback values clearly labeled.

details.text: Zoning variance need cannot be determined because required MF-2 setback standards are not displayed on the plans. Cannot verify whether any standard zoning setback reduction requiring a Board of Adjustment variance has been obtained, or whether such a variance is necessary.

runComments.comment: Zoning variance need cannot be determined. While the site plan shows point-to-point distances from buildings to property lines, the required MF-2 setback standards are not displayed on the plans. Therefore, it cannot be verified whether any standard zoning setback reduction requiring a Board of Adjustment variance has been obtained, or whether such a variance is even necessary.

details.text: Site is within recorded Mecey Subdivision (Vol. 73, Page 76, filed December 11, 1975). Platted setback lines may exist that differ from current code requirements. Plat shown on Sheet 2, but vision analysis did not identify platted setback lines differing from standard code. Review of recorded plat instrument required to determine if letter of non-enforcement from the City is required.

runComments.comment: Letter of non-enforcement requirement cannot be verified. The site is within the recorded Mecey Subdivision (Vol. 73, Page 76, filed December 11, 1975), and platted setback lines may exist that differ from current code requirements. The plat is shown on Sheet 2, but the vision analysis did not identify any platted setback lines that differ from standard code. A review of the plat recorded instrument is needed to determine if a letter of non-enforcement from the City is required.

comments.headline: Fence heights and design specifications not documented
comments.summary: Wood fences and retaining walls shown on site plan lack required height labels and design specifications per LDC § 25-2-899, preventing compliance verification.
comments.attn: All three fence findings flagged in only one review run. Fence height labeling is also critical for fire hydrant obstruction assessment (separate comment).

details.text: Fences and retaining walls shown on site plan along property perimeter (wood fence and concrete retaining walls noted on Sheets 9 and 31), but fence heights not labeled. Relationship between fence locations and building setback lines cannot be verified because required zoning setback lines are not drawn.

runComments.comment: Fences and retaining walls are shown on the site plan along the property perimeter (wood fence and concrete retaining walls noted on Sheets 9 and 31), but because required zoning setback lines are not drawn on the plans, the relationship between fence locations and building setback lines cannot be verified. Additionally, fence heights are not labeled.

details.text: Wood fences and concrete retaining walls depicted on site plan sheets, but no heights labeled on any sheet. Fence height limits under LDC § 25-2-899 (6 feet standard, 7 feet where grade change ≥ 1 foot, 8 feet under specific conditions) cannot be verified without labeled fence heights.

runComments.comment: Fence height compliance cannot be verified. Wood fences and concrete retaining walls are depicted on the site plan sheets, but no heights are labeled on any sheet. The fence height limits under LDC § 25-2-899 (6 feet standard, 7 feet where grade change ≥ 1 foot, 8 feet under specific conditions) cannot be verified without labeled fence heights.

details.text: Wooden privacy fences labeled on Landscape Plan (Sheet 31, H.6), but detailed specifications regarding picket design, spike prohibition, barbed/razor wire prohibition, and knuckle selvage chain link requirements under LDC § 25-2-899(I) (effective post-July 31, 2023) not provided. Construction type and design details insufficient to verify compliance.

runComments.comment: Fence design restriction compliance (post-July 31, 2023) cannot be verified. Wooden privacy fences are labeled on the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31, H.6), but detailed specifications regarding picket design, spike prohibition, barbed/razor wire prohibition, and knuckle selvage chain link requirements under LDC § 25-2-899(I) are not provided. Construction type and design details are insufficient to verify compliance.

comments.headline: Article 10 compatibility analysis missing or incomplete
comments.summary: Site may be within 75 feet of SF-3 triggering property at southern boundary, making Article 10 compatibility standards applicable. Required determinations, buffer width, triggering property identification, and analysis exhibit are missing or incomplete.
comments.attn: All four compatibility findings flagged only in run 3. Applicant marked 'No' for Article 10 applicability on consolidated application, but review agent assessed this may be incorrect. Verify distance from southern boundary to SF-3 property; if within 75 feet, Article 10 analysis is mandatory and applicant's determination must be corrected.

details.text: Article 10 compatibility standards applicability appears to have been incorrectly determined as 'No'. Site zoned MF-2 (less restrictive than MF-4) and located adjacent to SF-3-zoned property. SF-3 qualifies as triggering property under § 25-2-1053. If development within 75 feet of SF-3 property boundary, Article 10 compatibility standards apply. Clarify distance and, if triggered, prepare compatibility analysis and revised plans demonstrating Article 10 compliance.

runComments.comment: Article 10 compatibility standards applicability has been incorrectly determined. The site is zoned MF-2, which is less restrictive than MF-4, and is located adjacent to an SF-3-zoned property. SF-3 is SF-5 or more restrictive and qualifies as a triggering property under § 25-2-1053. If the development is within 75 feet of this SF-3 property boundary, Article 10 compatibility standards apply. The applicant marked 'No' on the consolidated application for compatibility standards applicability, but this appears to be incorrect. Clarify whether the southern boundary is within 75 feet of the triggering property, and if so, prepare a compatibility analysis and revised plans demonstrating Article 10 compliance.

details.text: If Article 10 compatibility triggered, required compatibility buffer not shown at correct width along shared property line. Buffer must be 25 feet wide (or 15 feet if development site is less than 75 feet wide from shared triggering property line), shown as landscaped zone complying with § 25-8-700 planting requirements, extending full length of property line shared with triggering property. No labeled, dimensioned buffer line appears on site plan or landscape plan.

runComments.comment: If Article 10 compatibility is triggered (site within 75 ft of SF-3 triggering property), the required compatibility buffer is not shown at the correct width along the shared property line. The compatibility buffer must be 25 feet wide (or 15 feet if the development site is less than 75 feet wide measured from the shared triggering property line), shown as a landscaped zone complying with § 25-8-700 planting requirements, and extending along the full length of the property line shared with the triggering property. No such labeled and dimensioned buffer line appears on the site plan or landscape plan.

details.text: Triggering property not clearly identified on site plan compatibility sheets with required information. While site plan vision analysis identified adjacent SF-3 zoning on south, no separate exhibit clearly labels triggering property with zoning designation (SF-3) and dwelling unit count required to confirm qualification under § 25-2-1053. Prepare compatibility exhibit showing triggering property location, zoning, and dwelling unit count on all relevant plan sheets.

runComments.comment: Triggering property or properties are not clearly identified on the site plan compatibility sheets with all required information. While the site plan vision analysis identified adjacent zoning labels (SF-3 on south), there is no separate compatibility exhibit clearly labeling the triggering property with its zoning designation (SF-3) and dwelling unit count (required to confirm it qualifies as a triggering property under § 25-2-1053). Prepare a compatibility exhibit showing the triggering property location, zoning, and dwelling unit count, and clearly label it on all relevant plan sheets.

details.text: Separate compatibility exhibit not provided or is incomplete. If Article 10 compatibility triggered, required standalone exhibit must show property boundaries, on-site and off-site zoning boundaries (including all triggering properties and applicable combining districts), distances from triggering property boundary to existing and proposed structures, distances to surface improvements (parking, driveways, drainage features), and existing structures on triggering properties. Required to demonstrate compliance with § 25-2-1061 (height limits), § 25-2-1062 (buffer), and § 25-2-1063 (screening).

runComments.comment: Separate compatibility exhibit is not provided or is incomplete. If Article 10 compatibility is triggered, the required standalone compatibility exhibit must show: property boundaries, on-site and off-site zoning boundaries (including all triggering properties and applicable combining districts), distances from triggering property boundary to existing and proposed structures, distances to surface improvements (parking, driveways, drainage features), and location of existing structures on triggering properties. This documentation is required to demonstrate compliance with § 25-2-1061 (height limits), § 25-2-1062 (buffer), and § 25-2-1063 (screening).

comments.headline: Fire department setback and hydrant access not verified
comments.summary: Fire department access setback compliance cannot be verified due to missing street centerline-to-building dimensions. Fire hydrant obstruction by fencing cannot be assessed without labeled fence heights.
comments.crossDep: Fire Department — clarify fire department access setback requirements for Valley View Road right-of-way and fire hydrant clearance standards.
comments.attn: Valley View Road right-of-way width listed as either 58 or 64 feet in project facts — verify correct width. Fence height labeling (see separate fence compliance comment) would also resolve fire hydrant obstruction assessment.

details.text: Fire department access setback compliance cannot be verified. Valley View Road right-of-way width is 58 or 64 feet (determination required). Buildings shown with dimensions from west property line (26.1' for Building 1, 24.3' for Building 8), but distance from street centerline to building faces not explicitly dimensioned on plans, preventing verification of 30-foot minimum setback requirement for streets with less than 60-foot right-of-way.

runComments.comment: Fire department access setback compliance cannot be verified. Facts.md indicates the Valley View Road right-of-way width is 58 or 64 feet (determination required). Buildings are shown with dimensions from the west property line (26.1' for Building 1, 24.3' for Building 8), but the distance from the street centerline to building faces is not explicitly dimensioned on the plans, preventing verification of the 30-foot minimum setback requirement for streets with less than 60-foot right-of-way.

details.text: Fire hydrant obstruction compliance cannot be verified. Fences and retaining walls shown on site plan, but fence heights not labeled on any sheet. Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) shows one existing and two proposed fire hydrants (near Building 6, Building 7, and outside northwest corner), but without labeled fence heights, potential obstruction of hydrant access by fencing 4 feet or greater cannot be assessed.

runComments.comment: Fire hydrant obstruction compliance cannot be verified. Fences and retaining walls are shown on the site plan, but fence heights are not labeled on any sheet. The Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) shows one existing and two proposed fire hydrants, but without labeled fence heights, the potential obstruction of hydrant access by fencing 4 feet or greater in height cannot be assessed.

comments.headline: Transformer pad clearances not documented
comments.summary: Four electrical transformer pads located on site lack required clearance zones and construction details per Austin Energy Design Criteria 1.10.4, preventing compliance verification.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy / Electrical Department — verify clearance dimensions and building construction type information for transformer pad compliance.

details.text: Four electrical transformer pads identified on Preliminary Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21): north of Building 2, between Buildings 4 and 5, west of Building 8, and south of Building 7. No clearance zones, radii, standoff distances, or construction details provided. Austin Energy Design Criteria 1.10.4 requires specific minimum clearances based on building construction type (e.g., 12 feet to non-masonry, 5 feet to brick/masonry, with values ranging 5–15 feet depending on structure and location). Provide transformer pad detail sheet showing clearance dimensions to all adjacent buildings and structures with building construction type notation.

runComments.comment: Transformer pad clearances are not shown or noted. Four electrical transformer pads are located on the site (identified on Sheet 21 north of Building 2, between Buildings 4 and 5, west of Building 8, and south of Building 7), but no clearance zones, radii, standoff distances, or notes regarding Austin Energy Design Criteria 1.10.4 clearance requirements (10 ft, 5 ft, 12 ft, or 15 ft depending on structure type and location) are graphically shown or labeled. Compliance cannot be verified.

Transformer pad clearances cannot be verified. Sheet 21 (Preliminary Electrical Design Plan) shows transformer locations on the site, but no clearance dimensions or construction details are provided demonstrating compliance with Austin Energy Design Criteria 1.10.4. The criteria require specific minimum clearances based on building construction type (e.g., 12 feet to non-masonry buildings, 5 feet to brick/masonry). Provide a transformer pad detail sheet showing clearance dimensions to all adjacent buildings and structures with notation of building construction type to verify compliance.
